samples: This module offers one reusable helper that runs an action you supply up to a set number of times, returns the first success, and, after each failure, pauses for a delay that starts short, doubles every time, and has a little random jitter added. If every attempt fails, it fails with a report of the attempt count and a text description of the most recent error, so the caller loses the original error type. It needs permission to use the clock and randomness, and it works with any failure type that can be turned into text. Two caveats before you adopt it: it also sleeps after the final failed attempt, which wastes time before giving up, and the sleep, duration and random-integer calls it relies on are not in the library list I know of, so check that they exist.

This is a reusable retry helper: it calls an action you supply up to a set number of times and returns the first success. After each failure it waits about 100 ms plus up to 25% random jitter, doubling the base delay each time, and if every attempt fails it fails with a report of the attempt count and the last error text (earlier errors are not kept). Before adopting it, note that it also sleeps after the final failed attempt before giving up, it needs the time and random permissions, and the sleep, duration and random-integer functions it relies on are not in the library listing I know of, so I can't confirm they exist.

This module offers a helper that runs a caller-supplied action up to a given number of times and returns the first success. After each failure it waits about 100 ms, doubling each time, plus up to 25% random jitter, and if every attempt fails it fails with a report of the attempt count and the last error, which is the only error kept. Before relying on it, note that it also waits after the final failed attempt before giving up, and that the time and random helpers it uses (sleeping, building a duration in milliseconds, picking a random integer) are not in the library list I was given, so I can't confirm they exist.

This module offers one reusable function that runs a caller-supplied action up to a given number of times and returns the first success. After each failure it records the error text and sleeps for a delay that starts at 100 ms and doubles every time, plus a random extra of up to a quarter of the current delay. If every attempt fails (or the attempt count is zero or less), it fails with a result giving the number of attempts and the last error, which includes its attempt number. Before adopting it, note that it also sleeps after the final failed attempt, which adds needless delay before giving up, and that the sleep, millisecond-duration and random-integer functions it relies on are not in the documented standard library list, so confirm they exist.

This retry helper runs a caller-supplied action up to a given number of times and returns the first success. After each failure it records the error text and sleeps for a delay that starts at 100 ms and doubles each time, plus random jitter of up to a quarter of the delay. If every attempt fails, it fails with a `GaveUp` value holding the attempt count and only the last error message. Before relying on it, note that it also sleeps after the final failed attempt, which wastes time, and that the sleep, duration and random-integer functions it uses are not in the documented standard library, so they may not exist.
